basic_info.description: Hot Mission District Mixed Use Investment Property  with the blend of Commercial and One Residential Flat.  While the Laundromat that occupies the Ground Floor Commercial space has a lease with pre-set annual increases, upon lease ending, there is no control on the rental value. Fully occupied and performing with stable tenancies, and benefits from potential TIC conversion with possible Fast Track Condo conversion for a Savvy Investor.  Opportunity, Stability, and Growth!!!
